en: Today we will continue our discussion of training neural networks.
zh: 今天我们继续讨论神经网络的训练。

en: Last week we derived backpropagation, so this week we focus on optimization.
zh: 上周我们推导了反向传播，所以本周我们重点讲优化。

en: The simplest optimizer is stochastic gradient descent.
zh: 最简单的优化器是随机梯度下降。

en: Instead of using the whole training set, we estimate the gradient from a small mini-batch.
zh: 我们不使用整个训练集，而是用一个小批量来估计梯度。

en: The learning rate controls the step size of each update.
zh: 学习率控制每次更新的步长。

en: If the learning rate is too large, the loss may oscillate or even diverge.
zh: 如果学习率太大，损失可能会震荡甚至发散。

en: If it is too small, training becomes painfully slow.
zh: 如果学习率太小，训练会变得非常慢。

en: In practice we often use cosine decay with a short warm-up period.
zh: 在实践中，我们常使用带有短暂预热阶段的余弦衰减。

en: Momentum helps the optimizer move faster along consistent gradient directions.
zh: 动量帮助优化器沿着梯度一致的方向更快地前进。

en: Adam combines momentum with an adaptive learning rate for each parameter.
zh: Adam将动量与每个参数的自适应学习率结合起来。

en: That is why Adam is the default choice for training transformers.
zh: 这就是为什么Adam是训练Transformer的默认选择。

en: For classification, we usually minimize the cross-entropy loss.
zh: 对于分类问题，我们通常最小化交叉熵损失。

en: A common mistake is to apply softmax twice, once in the model and once in the loss.
zh: 一个常见的错误是应用了两次softmax，一次在模型里，一次在损失函数里。

en: Please check this carefully in your code.
zh: 请在你的代码中仔细检查这一点。

en: When training accuracy keeps improving but validation accuracy drops, the model is overfitting.
zh: 当训练准确率持续提高而验证准确率下降时，模型就过拟合了。

en: Your model is simply memorizing the training data.
zh: 你的模型只是在记忆训练数据。

en: Weight decay, dropout and data augmentation can all reduce overfitting.
zh: 权重衰减、dropout和数据增强都可以减少过拟合。

en: Early stopping is also a very effective form of regularization.
zh: 早停也是一种非常有效的正则化方法。

en: Batch normalization normalizes the activations within each mini-batch.
zh: 批量归一化对每个小批量内的激活值进行归一化。

en: This stabilizes training and often allows a higher learning rate.
zh: 这能稳定训练，并且通常允许使用更高的学习率。

en: This point will definitely appear in the final exam.
zh: 这一点一定会出现在期末考试中。

en: Make sure you understand the difference between batch normalization and layer normalization.
zh: 请确保你理解批量归一化和层归一化之间的区别。

en: In attention, each token computes a weighted average of all other tokens.
zh: 在注意力机制中，每个词元计算所有其他词元的加权平均。

en: The weights come from the similarity between queries and keys.
zh: 这些权重来自查询和键之间的相似度。

en: We divide by the square root of the dimension to keep the dot products from growing too large.
zh: 我们除以维度的平方根，以防止点积变得过大。

en: Multi-head attention lets the model attend to different subspaces at the same time.
zh: 多头注意力让模型能够同时关注不同的子空间。

en: Positional encodings are needed because attention itself has no notion of order.
zh: 需要位置编码，因为注意力本身没有顺序的概念。

en: Let me write the formula on the board.
zh: 我把公式写在黑板上。

en: The derivative of the sigmoid function is sigmoid times one minus sigmoid.
zh: sigmoid函数的导数等于sigmoid乘以一减sigmoid。

en: ReLU avoids the vanishing gradient problem for positive inputs.
zh: 对于正输入，ReLU避免了梯度消失问题。
